newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian post office to lay off 3,000.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian post office to lay off 3,000.

text.p: The Nigerian Postal Service (NIPOST) is to lay off 3,000 of its 20,000 workers in a reorganisation that may start this week, the Daily Times reported on Wednesday.

The government-owned newspaper said unions had been told by the post-master general that staff to go would be those who have reached the age of 55, those who have worked for 35 years and those involved in fraud.

With a huge international debt Nigeria can no longer afford to plough money into fraud-ridden state enterprises that provide low levels of service, and NIPOST is widely seen as a target for possible privatisation.
Finance Minister Anthony Ani said in a recent interview that the military government was committed to privatising national electricity and telecommunications firms.
